resources.string: Includes shared and book labels. Drag to set this book’s priority; the first selected label determines the style.
Shared by all books. Drag to set the default priority for books without their own order.
Name, note and style changes apply to all books.
Only available in this book. When a shared label becomes book-only, other books keep their existing labels and order independently.
Remove “%1$s” from this book? Annotations, base styles and notes will be kept.
Drag to reorder. Among selected labels, the first determines the style.
Enter a name. If it already exists, select it from Add label.
No labels. Add one to get started.
Optional description of this label’s meaning or use
Tap to select a label; touch and hold to view its note
Choose labels to preview their style.
Save and apply to all books
Existing annotations will use the updated label styles.
Remove “%1$s” from all books? Annotations, their base styles and notes will be kept.
This edits the annotation’s base style, used when no labels are selected.
Move %1$s. Drag, or use the up and down keys.
Could not save labels. Your changes have been kept.
Type a name to find or create a label
Select an existing label, or locate one already added to this book.
Star labels to show them in all books by default. Add other labels as needed; drag to set this book’s order.
Any label can be reused. Name, style and description edits apply to all books using it.
Changes to this label apply to annotations using it. Each annotation keeps its own note.
Hide “%1$s” from this book’s choices? Existing annotations keep their labels, styles and notes. Other books are unaffected; you can add it again later.

“%1$s” is used in %2$d books and %3$d annotations. Permanent deletion removes it from all choices and annotations. Annotations and notes remain; another selected label determines the style, or the original base style is restored.
This book already has a label named “%1$s”. Existing annotations with that label will use the selected label’s style and description. Annotation notes remain. The original label stays in the library.
